title: Retire the dead common-review Decision assembly module
summary: src/assayer_platform/common_review_decision.py defines assemble_common_review_decisions, a Host-owned assembler that projected legacy common-review coverage into per-WorkItem results using the retired v1 result vocabulary (issue_found, scanned_no_issue, needs_review). The compiled runtime now owns review planning, coverage and terminal decisions through compiled_interactive.py, incremental_review.py and kernel.py, and nothing in the repository imports the module: the only importer is tests/test_common_review_decision.py, it is not re-exported by assayer_platform/__init__.py or public_surface.py, and no document names it. This change deletes the dead module and its test and adds architecture-gate guards so the retired module path and the assemble_common_review_decisions symbol cannot return. No live compiled review path, Kernel decision gate, v1 SDK schema, plugin or provider surface, or shipped document changes: the frozen v1 result vocabulary in assayer_plugin_sdk stays untouched, and the live common-review types in common_review.py keep their importers in review_projection.py, incremental_review_runtime.py and review_binding.py. Verification evidence: the change landed in 125ad6a, pushed on 2026-09-17 with 125ad6a as the publish point, and CI run 35215434194 passed all seven jobs (Fast on Python 3.11, 3.12 and 3.13, Full on 3.11 and 3.13, and Install matrix on 3.11 and 3.13 including the clean-environment compiled acceptance); locally the architecture check returns 0 with seventeen boundary tests passing, the fast profile reported 430 tests OK and full reported 443 tests OK, the design confirmation gate passes over the a36f734..125ad6a range, and the document, plugin-source, English text and resilience gates all returned 0.

platform: Platform governance owns the retired common-review Decision assembler and the architecture gate that guards it
plugin: No plugin change; ordinary plugins remain declaration-only

forbiddenResponsibilities: The change must not alter the live compiled review path, the Kernel decision gate, the frozen v1 SDK result vocabulary, or any live decision state
The change must not remove common_review.py or any module that still has a live importer
The change must not weaken the architecture gate for live platform modules
acceptance: no live module imports or re-exports assemble_common_review_decisions
the architecture gate rejects the retired module path and the assemble_common_review_decisions symbol
the architecture, document, plugin-source, English text and resilience gates return 0 and the fast and full profiles stay green

humanApproval.decision: Release-surface change carried out under the standing authorization of the refactor mandate in #assayer-group:4c84ee19 and its delegation update, under which the agent and reviewer decide these changes themselves within at most seven workflow rounds. The classification is breaking because the assayer-platform wheel stops shipping the assayer_platform.common_review_decision module; the evidence that nothing in the repository imported it is recorded in the summary. @assayer_rev independently reviews the batch and has previously required that a published-surface removal be classified as a release change.
